description: Searches SEC EDGAR's full text for a firm, a fund or a person's name and returns the matching filings, newest first: filer, CIK, form, filing date, accession number and the primary document's URL. Form D (a private fund or company raising money) is the default; pass forms such as ADV or 13F-HR for others. A person named in a Form D is a related person of that issuer, not necessarily its investor. Read a Form D with fundraising_get_sec_form_d. Public records, read-only.
name: fundraising_search_sec_filings
title: Search Sec Filings
